note: apex-seh-probe-correct-1120 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; probe-out/apex-pr-seh-probe-1120.md): Apex Radiance 4.0.12 raises tens of thousands of first-chance access violations per session in its lot story reads (ApexRadiance.asi+0x12A048 / +0x12A054 LotStoryManager, +0x133F77 ReadCutExtras, +0x12A9BA ReadXform; 90558 in jit-vslot-correct-1120-rerun1 bp-vslot-on) and catches them itself. Fork branch fix/no-seh-probe-1120 replaces those reads with non-faulting checks. Two jobs on the same save, seed and ts3native set (hotfix hf031: JIT FaultRecover leaves foreign faults alone), run by probe-out/queue/chain-apex-seh-probe-1120.sh with --only per job: bp-av-stock = Bin state apex with the stock 4.0.12 release asi; bp-av-fixed = Bin state apex with game-copy/apex-seh-probe-test/ApexRadiance.asi (fork build, sha pinned in the chain). Measure: the last 'crash log: N more AVs at logged addresses' line per job (total and per address) and the foreign-fault tick line. PASS for bp-av-fixed: no logged AV inside the fixed functions of the fork build (LotStoryManager 0x12A0E0-0x12A16F, ReadXform 0x12AA90-0x12AB5F, ReadCutExtras 0x133F90-0x13411F, from its map). bp-av-stock only measures; its logRequire on the stock offsets proves the stock asi ran. Measurement only, no Sim changed (household check n/a). ~2 x 15 min.
